chunks.text: What Are TrueMark Objects? — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout ← Back to TrueMark Mint What Are TrueMark Objects? TrueMark Objects are structured digital artifacts that represent verified knowledge, intellectual work, or meaningful historical records. Instead of being simple files or speculative tokens, a TrueMark Object combines several elements into a durable digital record. • The original artifact (document, knowledge, media, etc.) • A forensic certificate verifying its origin • A structured identifier • Authorship attribution • Timestamp verification • Preservation metadata Together these elements transform ordinary information into a verified digital object with a permanent record of origin. Why TrueMark Objects Exist Most knowledge today lives in fragile places: > PDFs that disappear > Cloud folders that get lost > Platforms that shut down > Research that loses attribution > Family knowledge that dies with a generation TrueMark Objects were created to solve this problem. They turn important knowledge into durable digital assets that can be preserved, verified, and transferred over time. Types of TrueMark Objects TrueMark uses several object types depending on the nature of the knowledge being preserved. K-NFT Knowledge Object A single artifact such as a book, document, research paper, or instructional guide. KL-NFT Knowledge License Collection A structured set of knowledge designed for licensing, such as courses, masterclasses, or training programs. H-NFT Heirloom Object Family knowledge intended to be passed down across generations, such as recipes, traditions, or historical records. L-NFT Legacy Object Major intellectual contributions or lifetime works preserved for long-term historical value. E-NFT Enterprise Object Organizational artifacts such as research records, technical documentation, or certified institutional data. What Makes Them Valuable TrueMark Objects can support multiple forms of use and transfer. Depending on the creator's intent, an object may be: Sold Licensed Transferred Collected Inherited The value comes from the knowledge or artifact itself , while TrueMark provides the structure that preserves its authenticity and history. In Simple Terms A TrueMark Object turns knowledge into something that can be: Preserved Verified Owned Licensed or passed down to future generations. © 2026 spruked . Truth with teeth. chunks.text: About — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout About Spruked Spruked is a digital architecture studio focused on building systems that preserve knowledge, verify authenticity, and organize digital assets for the future . At its core, Spruked develops tools that allow individuals, professionals, and organizations to capture what they know, prove when it existed, and preserve it in a verifiable form . The modern world produces an overwhelming amount of information, but very little of it is structured, authenticated, or preserved in a meaningful way . Spruked exists to change that. Through a growing ecosystem of technologies — including CertSig™, TrueMark™, GOAT, and the Pro Prime Series AI systems — Spruked builds infrastructure that transforms knowledge into a durable digital asset. If knowledge has value, it deserves to be preserved properly. The Philosophy Spruked is built on a simple belief: "If better is possible, good is never enough." Most software is built to solve immediate problems. Spruked focuses on building systems that still make sense decades from now. The design philosophy emphasizes: Clarity over complexity Verification over assumption Permanence over convenience Discipline over novelty This approach guides every system within the Spruked ecosystem. What Spruked Builds Spruked develops several interconnected systems designed to support the preservation and verification of knowledge and digital artifacts. Key components include: CertSig™ A forensic-grade certificate system designed to produce verifiable digital records with layered authentication and metadata. CertSig allows documents, knowledge artifacts, and creative works to be issued with structured verification layers and optional blockchain anchoring. TrueMark™ A minting and verification framework that allows knowledge, intellectual property, and expertise to be issued as structured digital assets . The goal is not speculation or hype — but preservation and attribution. GOAT The GOAT system prepares and organizes digital artifacts before they are issued or archived. It acts as the preparation layer that ensures artifacts are structured, documented, and ready for long-term preservation. Pro Prime Series AI The Pro Prime Series explores the future of ethical, verifiable AI cognition systems . These systems focus on transparency, traceability, and philosophical grounding rather than opaque automation. Architecture draws inspiration from classical philosophy: Locke, Hume, Kant, and Spinoza. Why It Exists The internet solved distribution. It did not solve authenticity, permanence, or ownership of knowledge . Ideas disappear. Expertise is lost. Proof of authorship fades. Spruked exists to build the infrastructure that prevents that. The Founder My name is Bryan Spruk . I am a builder, salesman, systems thinker, and founder of the Pro Prime Series AI ecosystem. My professional background is not traditional. I did not come through a university program, venture studio, or corporate engineering track. I came through work: automotive sales, business development, welding, machining, entrepreneurship, customer service, and years of solving problems with limited resources. That background shaped the way I build. I tend to think in systems, structures, workflows, and practical outcomes. I am not interested in technology for show. I am interested in tools that help real people preserve knowledge, operate better, protect privacy, and turn difficult work into something usable. The projects I am building, including ORBS, GOAT, True Mark, CertSig, and related Pro Prime systems , come from that same place. chunks.heading: ExampleTrueMark Object
chunks.text: spruked — Truth with teeth. spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout Example TrueMark Object Certified Digital Knowledge Artifact This certificate demonstrates what a finalized TrueMark digital object looks like after verification and preservation. Each artifact issued through the Spruked ecosystem receives a structured forensic certificate containing verification metadata, identifiers, and authentication layers. The certificate serves as the human-readable verification layer that accompanies the digital artifact. Download Artifact Sample Example Object Record Object Identifier K-NFT-SPRUK-ENG-2026-000014 Artifact Precision Lathe Retrofit Method Creator Bryan Anthony Spruk Category K-NFT Knowledge Object Verification 10-Layer Forensic Certificate Encryption ChaCha20-Poly1305 Certificate Elements Structured Identifier Every object is assigned a permanent identifier. Example: E-NFT-MAYO-MED-2026-000002 This identifier encodes: object type issuing prefix industry category year of issuance sequential object record Forensic Verification Layers Alpha CertSig certificates may include up to 10 forensic verification layers . These layers document technical information about the artifact including: file format verification resolution analysis cryptographic signatures metadata preservation structural integrity checks Encryption Layer Optional encryption modules protect the artifact and certificate from unauthorized alteration. The flagship configuration supports: ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption This provides authenticated encryption for high-security digital artifacts. QR Verification Each certificate may include a QR code linking to a verification endpoint or registry entry. This allows the certificate to be quickly verified using a mobile device. TrueMark Seal The TrueMark seal indicates that the object has been issued within the curated registry and has passed the required verification processes. The seal acts as a visual authenticity marker for the artifact. Why the Certificate Matters The certificate transforms a simple file into a verifiable digital artifact . Instead of existing as an isolated document, the artifact becomes a structured record containing: authorship timestamped origin forensic verification permanent identification preservation metadata This ensures that the knowledge or artifact can be verified long after its original creation. Where Certificates Come From Certificates like this are generated through the Alpha CertSig mint engine . The engine performs the verification steps, generates the structured identifier, and produces the forensic certificate that accompanies the artifact. Selected artifacts may also appear in the TrueMark registry , preserving them within the curated archive of digital knowledge objects. Explore Alpha CertSig View TrueMark Registry © 2026 spruked . chunks.heading: TrueMark DigitalObject Types
chunks.text: TrueMark Digital Object Types — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout ← Back to TrueMark Mint TrueMark Digital Object Types Understanding Knowledge NFTs TrueMark objects are designed to preserve knowledge, expertise, and meaningful digital artifacts in a structured and verifiable form. Unlike speculative NFTs, TrueMark objects represent real intellectual artifacts that can be preserved, licensed, transferred, or inherited over time. Each NFT type exists to serve a different purpose in the preservation of knowledge and digital legacy. K-NFT Knowledge Object KL-NFT Licensed Knowledge H-NFT Heirloom Object L-NFT Legacy Object E-NFT Enterprise Object K-NFT Knowledge Object A K-NFT represents a single intellectual artifact or a tightly related set of artifacts. These objects preserve a specific piece of knowledge in a durable digital format. Examples A single book or manuscript A research paper A technical document An engineering method A proprietary process An instructional guide A creative work Value Model A K-NFT can be: Sold to another party Licensed for use or distribution Transferred to institutions or collectors In many cases, a K-NFT functions like a digital edition of an intellectual artifact , preserved with permanent authorship and timestamp verification. Certificate Representation KL-NFT Knowledge License Collection A KL-NFT represents a structured collection of knowledge artifacts designed for licensing and distribution. Where a K-NFT represents a single artifact, a KL-NFT represents a complete knowledge system. Examples Professional training courses Masterclass programs Structured learning systems Educational curriculum Research collections Multi-part technical instruction Value Model KL-NFTs are designed to be licensed repeatedly . Owners may: License access to the content Distribute learning programs Offer certification or training based on the material This makes KL-NFTs ideal for educators, subject-matter experts, and organizations that want to preserve and distribute structured expertise. H-NFT Heirloom Object An H-NFT preserves knowledge and artifacts intended to be passed down across generations. These objects focus on family legacy and cultural preservation. Examples Family recipes Letters to future generations Historical family documents Farming knowledge passed through generations Craftsmanship techniques Cultural traditions These artifacts may contain knowledge that has been preserved within families for decades or even centuries. Value Model Heirloom NFTs may be: Inherited across generations Preserved as family archives Licensed if the knowledge becomes valuable to others The primary goal of an H-NFT is preservation and continuity of family knowledge. L-NFT Legacy Object An L-NFT represents significant intellectual contributions or life-work artifacts. These objects often preserve work that has long-term historical or intellectual importance. Examples Major discoveries Important technical designs Lifetime research collections Influential creative works Historical documentation Legacy NFTs preserve the long-term intellectual footprint of a creator or organization. Value Model Legacy objects may be: Transferred to archives or institutions Preserved as historical records Licensed for educational or research use These artifacts are often created to ensure that meaningful contributions are not lost over time. E-NFT Enterprise Object An E-NFT represents digital objects created by organizations or institutions. These objects often originate from systems such as Alpha CertSig infrastructure and may represent internal or external artifacts. Examples Institutional research Certified documentation Technical specifications Digital twins Product documentation Corporate intellectual property Value Model Enterprise objects are typically used to: Preserve internal kno

Truth with teeth. Precision correction. No fluff. No mercy. Spruked - Where Objects Tell the Truth. A registry for verified records, provenance, and intelligent object profiles. Get Spruked Contact Orb Skin Studio Demo What does it mean to be Spruked ? Spruking is the act of delivering correction with precision and authority. It’s not vague feedback. It’s not polite criticism. It’s the moment someone who knows better steps in and says: “Here’s what you missed. Here’s what’s actually true. Here’s how to fix it.” TrueMark Objects TrueMark Objects transform knowledge, expertise, and meaningful digital artifacts into verified digital records that can be preserved, licensed, traded, or inherited across generations. My focus is simple: build local-first, privacy-conscious systems that help people preserve knowledge, protect ownership, and operate with more control over their data and digital presence. semantic_analysis.content_excerpt: What Are TrueMark Objects? — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout ← Back to TrueMark Mint What Are TrueMark Objects? TrueMark Objects are structured digital artifacts that represent verified knowledge, intellectual work, or meaningful historical records. Instead of being simple files or speculative tokens, a TrueMark Object combines several elements into a durable digital record. • The original artifact (document, knowledge, media, etc.) • A forensic certificate verifying its origin • A structured identifier • Authorship attribution • Timestamp verification • Preservation metadata Together these elements transform ordinary information into a verified digital object with a permanent record of origin. Why TrueMark Objects Exist Most knowledge today lives in fragile places: > PDFs that disappear > Cloud folders that get lost > Platforms that shut down > Research that loses attribution > Family knowledge that dies with a generation TrueMark Objects were created to solve this problem. They turn important knowledge into durable digital assets that can be preserved, verified, and transferred over time. Types of TrueMark Objects TrueMark uses several object types depending on the nature of the knowledge being preserved. K-NFT Knowledge Object A single artifact such as a book, document, research paper, or instructional guide. KL-NFT Knowledge License Collection A structured set of knowledge designed for licensing, such as courses, masterclasses, or training programs. H-NFT Heirloom Object Family knowledge intended to be passed down across generations, such as recipes, traditions, or historical records. L-NFT Legacy Object Major intellectual contributions or lifetime works preserved for long-term historical value. E-NFT Enterprise Object Organizational artifacts such as research records, technical documentation, or certified institutional data. What Makes Them Valuable TrueMark Objects can support multiple forms of use and transfer. Depending on the creator's intent, an object may be: Sold Licensed Transferred Collected Inherited The value comes from the knowledge or artifact itself , while TrueMark provides the structure that preserves its authenticity and history. In Simple Terms A TrueMark Object turns knowledge into something that can be: Preserved Verified Owned Licensed or passed down to future generations. © 2026 spruked . Truth with teeth. semantic_analysis.content_excerpt: TrueMark Mint — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout TrueMark Mint Curated Registry Alpha CertSig Licensed Infrastructure TrueMark Mint The Curated Digital Object Vault TrueMark Mint is the founder-curated registry of verified digital knowledge objects issued through the Spruked ecosystem. Unlike typical NFT platforms that allow anyone to mint anything, TrueMark focuses on authenticity, provenance, and preservation of meaningful intellectual artifacts. Each object issued through TrueMark is intended to represent something real: Knowledge Expertise Creative work Technical documentation Intellectual property Personal legacy artifacts The goal is not speculation. The goal is preservation with attribution. The Distinction The Spruked ecosystem contains two different minting systems. TrueMark Mint The Curated Registry Artifacts issued through TrueMark are selected and issued through the founder vault. TrueMark is the museum. Alpha CertSig Licensed Infrastructure Organizations install and operate their own mint engine. Alpha CertSig is the printing press. This distinction protects the credibility and long-term integrity of the registry. What TrueMark Mints TrueMark issues Digital Knowledge Objects. These are structured artifacts designed to preserve valuable intellectual content. Examples include: Research findings Instructional knowledge Professional expertise Creative works Personal legacy messages Technical documentation Historical records Each object is preserved as a structured digital asset tied to a permanent certificate. The Digital Knowledge Object Model Traditional NFTs often represent artwork or speculative collectibles. TrueMark focuses on knowledge artifacts. A knowledge object includes: • The original artifact • A forensic certificate • A structured identifier • Authorship attribution • Timestamp verification • Preservation metadata These elements transform a simple file into a verified digital object. NFT Types in the TrueMark Registry TrueMark supports multiple object categories. K-NFT Knowledge Objects Knowledge NFTs preserve expertise and educational content. Examples include: Specialized tutorials Professional training Proprietary methods Technical insights These artifacts allow knowledge to be preserved and transferred across generations. H-NFT Heirloom Objects Heirloom NFTs preserve personal legacy artifacts. Examples include: Letters to future generations Family knowledge Personal messages Historical records These objects focus on long-term preservation of personal history. L-NFT Legacy Objects Legacy NFTs preserve significant intellectual or creative work. Examples include: Published works Major technical designs Documented discoveries Historical contributions These artifacts represent the long-term intellectual footprint of their creator. E-NFT Enterprise Objects Enterprise NFTs represent verified organizational artifacts. Examples include: Institutional records Internal research Certified documentation Digital twins Enterprise artifacts are often produced through Alpha CertSig infrastructure and may optionally appear in the TrueMark registry. Why TrueMark Exists Modern knowledge is fragile. > Files disappear. > Platforms vanish. > Creators lose attribution. TrueMark exists to ensure that meaningful digital artifacts are preserved with structure, verification, and historical context. Instead of existing as scattered files, knowledge becomes a durable digital object with a permanent record of origin. The Value of an Object Authorship Clear identification of the creator. pages.meta_description: Spruked is a digital architecture studio focused on building systems that preserve knowledge, verify authenticity, and organize digital assets for the future.

semantic_analysis.content_excerpt: About — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout About Spruked Spruked is a digital architecture studio focused on building systems that preserve knowledge, verify authenticity, and organize digital assets for the future . At its core, Spruked develops tools that allow individuals, professionals, and organizations to capture what they know, prove when it existed, and preserve it in a verifiable form . The modern world produces an overwhelming amount of information, but very little of it is structured, authenticated, or preserved in a meaningful way . Spruked exists to change that. Through a growing ecosystem of technologies — including CertSig™, TrueMark™, GOAT, and the Pro Prime Series AI systems — Spruked builds infrastructure that transforms knowledge into a durable digital asset. If knowledge has value, it deserves to be preserved properly. The Philosophy Spruked is built on a simple belief: "If better is possible, good is never enough." Most software is built to solve immediate problems. Spruked focuses on building systems that still make sense decades from now. The design philosophy emphasizes: Clarity over complexity Verification over assumption Permanence over convenience Discipline over novelty This approach guides every system within the Spruked ecosystem. What Spruked Builds Spruked develops several interconnected systems designed to support the preservation and verification of knowledge and digital artifacts. Key components include: CertSig™ A forensic-grade certificate system designed to produce verifiable digital records with layered authentication and metadata. CertSig allows documents, knowledge artifacts, and creative works to be issued with structured verification layers and optional blockchain anchoring. TrueMark™ A minting and verification framework that allows knowledge, intellectual property, and expertise to be issued as structured digital assets . The goal is not speculation or hype — but preservation and attribution. GOAT The GOAT system prepares and organizes digital artifacts before they are issued or archived. It acts as the preparation layer that ensures artifacts are structured, documented, and ready for long-term preservation. Pro Prime Series AI The Pro Prime Series explores the future of ethical, verifiable AI cognition systems . These systems focus on transparency, traceability, and philosophical grounding rather than opaque automation. Architecture draws inspiration from classical philosophy: Locke, Hume, Kant, and Spinoza. Why It Exists The internet solved distribution. It did not solve authenticity, permanence, or ownership of knowledge . Ideas disappear. Expertise is lost. Proof of authorship fades. Spruked exists to build the infrastructure that prevents that. The Founder My name is Bryan Spruk . I am a builder, salesman, systems thinker, and founder of the Pro Prime Series AI ecosystem. My professional background is not traditional. I did not come through a university program, venture studio, or corporate engineering track. I came through work: automotive sales, business development, welding, machining, entrepreneurship, customer service, and years of solving problems with limited resources. That background shaped the way I build. I tend to think in systems, structures, workflows, and practical outcomes. I am not interested in technology for show. I am interested in tools that help real people preserve knowledge, operate better, protect privacy, and turn difficult work into something usable. The projects I am building, including ORBS, GOAT, True Mark, CertSig, and related Pro Prime systems , come from that same place. They are local-first, privacy-conscious, practical systems designed to give individuals and small businesses more control over their own data, memory, work, and digital presence. semantic_analysis.content_excerpt: The GOAT — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout Legacy Preservation Engine Stop the second death. Build a GOAT-grade archive. GOAT The GOAT transforms memories into narrated films, AI-personalized letters, and living archives. Every artifact is authenticated, contextualized, and preserved so legacies never vanish. The phrase "truth with teeth" represents the Spruked philosophy. className="rounded-full bg-light px-8 py-3 text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.4em] text-dark hover:bg-truth hover:text-light" > Book a Legacy Session Watch a Demo Pillars How the GOAT engine works 4K / Spatial audio / Multi-camera Capture raw memories High-definition interview capture plus timeline ingestion. We collect the receipts before they fade. Custom narration • Controlled prompts Train the voice AI models fine-tuned on authentic speech + writing patterns. Output sounds like you because it is sourced from you. Secure vault • Shareable links Premiere the film Cinematic edits, letter drops, and vault delivery. The family receives an interactive vault—never a dusty drive. Timeline From intake to premiere 01. Intake White-glove onboarding. We map the story, surface gaps, and schedule capture. 02. Capture Studio-grade capture kit shipped or crew on-site. Memories, artifacts, and context collected. 03. Training Audio + text models trained. Narration and letters generated, reviewed, and truth-checked. 04. Premiere Final film plus vault delivered. Optional livestream premiere with private Q&A. Promises What never compromises Truth-first storytelling Every claim footnoted. Source docs live beside the film so fact and sentiment never separate. Private by default End-to-end encrypted vault. You decide who sees what, and when. Living archive Schedule future drops: letters on birthdays, narrated advice, AI-guided tours of the archive. Ready to build the GOAT version of your story? semantic_analysis.content_excerpt: Alpha CertSig Mint Engine — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout Alpha CertSig Elite Mint Engine Sovereign Digital Object Infrastructure Alpha CertSig is a self-hosted mint engine designed for institutions and sovereign creators who need forensic-grade digital object issuance without relying on third-party platforms. Unlike marketplace NFT systems, Alpha CertSig operates as licensed infrastructure that runs inside your own environment. Organizations use it to mint: Digital records Intellectual property Digital twins Certified documents Institutional knowledge objects The result is a structured, verifiable digital artifact that can be preserved indefinitely. The Market Has Changed The first wave of NFTs focused on speculation. The next wave focuses on infrastructure. Modern organizations are not interested in collectible tokens. They need systems capable of issuing forensic digital objects with long-term evidentiary value. They care about: Immutable internal records Forensic timestamping Digital twin infrastructure Verifiable intellectual property Sovereign data control Alpha CertSig was built for this new reality. The Key Distinction Two systems exist in the Spruked ecosystem. Alpha CertSig The licensed mint engine. Self-hosted Deployable infrastructure Licensable to organizations and individuals Designed for internal minting and digital object issuance True Mark Mint The founder's curated vault. Not licensable Not installable Not commoditized True Mark functions as the museum. Alpha CertSig is the printing press. This distinction remains permanent. Core Capabilities Infrastructure Ownership With Alpha CertSig, you purchase the engine once. There are no per-mint fees and no platform dependency. After the system is deployed, the cost of issuing digital objects approaches zero. Epistemic Sovereignty The system runs inside your own environment. Supported deployment models include: Docker Linux servers WSL2 environments Private blockchain networks No telemetry is required. Your records never leave your infrastructure. Forensic Certificate Architecture Alpha CertSig supports a multi-layer certificate structure. The flagship configuration includes 10 layers of forensic metadata embedded into each certificate. Optional encryption support includes: ChaCha20 secure object encryption Structured digital object identifiers Prefix-based registry architecture Example identifier: E-NFT-MAYO-MED-2026-000002 This identifier format creates a structured digital object record rather than a simple token reference. Example Certificate Output Example Forensic Certificate Output Generated by the Alpha CertSig mint engine and issued within the TrueMark registry. View Detailed Object Breakdown The Problems Alpha CertSig Solves The SaaS Tax Many platforms charge subscription fees plus minting costs. Alpha CertSig eliminates the platform dependency by giving organizations direct ownership of the mint engine. Data Sovereignty Sensitive documents and research often pass through third-party servers. Alpha CertSig performs all minting locally, allowing organizations to maintain complete control of their data. Evidentiary Weight Typical NFTs rely on lightweight metadata. Alpha CertSig produces structured objects designed for auditability, traceability, and institutional recordkeeping. Institutional Memory Loss Knowledge often disappears as staff turnover occurs. Alpha CertSig creates a structured digital library of internal knowledge artifacts that remain searchable and verifiable. Licensing Options Alpha CertSig is offered through a one-time license model with optional annual maintenance updates. Personal Node $3,900 License $500 Annual Maintenance (Optional) Includes: • Single prefix registry • 5-layer certificate system • DIY deployment • Community support Designed for developers and creators entering

semantic_analysis.content_excerpt: spruked — Truth with teeth. spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout Example TrueMark Object Certified Digital Knowledge Artifact This certificate demonstrates what a finalized TrueMark digital object looks like after verification and preservation. Each artifact issued through the Spruked ecosystem receives a structured forensic certificate containing verification metadata, identifiers, and authentication layers. The certificate serves as the human-readable verification layer that accompanies the digital artifact. Download Artifact Sample Example Object Record Object Identifier K-NFT-SPRUK-ENG-2026-000014 Artifact Precision Lathe Retrofit Method Creator Bryan Anthony Spruk Category K-NFT Knowledge Object Verification 10-Layer Forensic Certificate Encryption ChaCha20-Poly1305 Certificate Elements Structured Identifier Every object is assigned a permanent identifier. Example: E-NFT-MAYO-MED-2026-000002 This identifier encodes: object type issuing prefix industry category year of issuance sequential object record Forensic Verification Layers Alpha CertSig certificates may include up to 10 forensic verification layers . These layers document technical information about the artifact including: file format verification resolution analysis cryptographic signatures metadata preservation structural integrity checks Encryption Layer Optional encryption modules protect the artifact and certificate from unauthorized alteration. The flagship configuration supports: ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption This provides authenticated encryption for high-security digital artifacts. QR Verification Each certificate may include a QR code linking to a verification endpoint or registry entry. This allows the certificate to be quickly verified using a mobile device. TrueMark Seal The TrueMark seal indicates that the object has been issued within the curated registry and has passed the required verification processes. The seal acts as a visual authenticity marker for the artifact. Why the Certificate Matters The certificate transforms a simple file into a verifiable digital artifact . Instead of existing as an isolated document, the artifact becomes a structured record containing: authorship timestamped origin forensic verification permanent identification preservation metadata This ensures that the knowledge or artifact can be verified long after its original creation. Where Certificates Come From Certificates like this are generated through the Alpha CertSig mint engine . The engine performs the verification steps, generates the structured identifier, and produces the forensic certificate that accompanies the artifact. Selected artifacts may also appear in the TrueMark registry , preserving them within the curated archive of digital knowledge objects. Explore Alpha CertSig View TrueMark Registry © 2026 spruked . semantic_analysis.content_excerpt: TrueMark Digital Object Types — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout ← Back to TrueMark Mint TrueMark Digital Object Types Understanding Knowledge NFTs TrueMark objects are designed to preserve knowledge, expertise, and meaningful digital artifacts in a structured and verifiable form. Unlike speculative NFTs, TrueMark objects represent real intellectual artifacts that can be preserved, licensed, transferred, or inherited over time. Each NFT type exists to serve a different purpose in the preservation of knowledge and digital legacy. K-NFT Knowledge Object KL-NFT Licensed Knowledge H-NFT Heirloom Object L-NFT Legacy Object E-NFT Enterprise Object K-NFT Knowledge Object A K-NFT represents a single intellectual artifact or a tightly related set of artifacts. These objects preserve a specific piece of knowledge in a durable digital format. Examples A single book or manuscript A research paper A technical document An engineering method A proprietary process An instructional guide A creative work Value Model A K-NFT can be: Sold to another party Licensed for use or distribution Transferred to institutions or collectors In many cases, a K-NFT functions like a digital edition of an intellectual artifact , preserved with permanent authorship and timestamp verification. Certificate Representation KL-NFT Knowledge License Collection A KL-NFT represents a structured collection of knowledge artifacts designed for licensing and distribution. Where a K-NFT represents a single artifact, a KL-NFT represents a complete knowledge system. Examples Professional training courses Masterclass programs Structured learning systems Educational curriculum Research collections Multi-part technical instruction Value Model KL-NFTs are designed to be licensed repeatedly . Owners may: License access to the content Distribute learning programs Offer certification or training based on the material This makes KL-NFTs ideal for educators, subject-matter experts, and organizations that want to preserve and distribute structured expertise. H-NFT Heirloom Object An H-NFT preserves knowledge and artifacts intended to be passed down across generations. These objects focus on family legacy and cultural preservation. Examples Family recipes Letters to future generations Historical family documents Farming knowledge passed through generations Craftsmanship techniques Cultural traditions These artifacts may contain knowledge that has been preserved within families for decades or even centuries. Value Model Heirloom NFTs may be: Inherited across generations Preserved as family archives Licensed if the knowledge becomes valuable to others The primary goal of an H-NFT is preservation and continuity of family knowledge. L-NFT Legacy Object An L-NFT represents significant intellectual contributions or life-work artifacts. These objects often preserve work that has long-term historical or intellectual importance. Examples Major discoveries Important technical designs Lifetime research collections Influential creative works Historical documentation Legacy NFTs preserve the long-term intellectual footprint of a creator or organization. Value Model Legacy objects may be: Transferred to archives or institutions Preserved as historical records Licensed for educational or research use These artifacts are often created to ensure that meaningful contributions are not lost over time. E-NFT Enterprise Object An E-NFT represents digital objects created by organizations or institutions. These objects often originate from systems such as Alpha CertSig infrastructure and may represent internal or external artifacts. Examples Institutional research Certified documentation Technical specifications Digital twins Product documentation Corporate intellectual property Value Model Enterprise objects are typically used to: Preserve internal kno

page_knowledge.title: What Are TrueMark Objects? — Spruked
page_knowledge.summary: TrueMark Objects are structured digital artifacts that represent verified knowledge, intellectual work, or meaningful historical records.
page_knowledge.content_excerpt: What Are TrueMark Objects? — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout ← Back to TrueMark Mint What Are TrueMark Objects? TrueMark Objects are structured digital artifacts that represent verified knowledge, intellectual work, or meaningful historical records. Instead of being simple files or speculative tokens, a TrueMark Object combines several elements into a durable digital record. • The original artifact (document, knowledge, media, etc.) • A forensic certificate verifying its origin • A structured identifier • Authorship attribution • Timestamp verification • Preservation metadata Together these elements transform ordinary information into a verified digital object with a permanent record of origin. Why TrueMark Objects Exist Most knowledge today lives in fragile places: > PDFs that disappear > Cloud folders that get lost > Platforms that shut down > Research that loses attribution > Family knowledge that dies with a generation TrueMark Objects were created to solve this problem. They turn important knowledge into durable digital assets that can be preserved, verified, and transferred over time. Types of TrueMark Objects TrueMark uses several object types depending on the nature of the knowledge being preserved. K-NFT Knowledge Object A single artifact such as a book, document, research paper, or instructional guide. KL-NFT Knowledge License Collection A structured set of knowledge designed for licensing, such as courses, masterclasses, or training programs. H-NFT Heirloom Object Family knowledge intended to be passed down across generations, such as recipes, traditions, or historical records. L-NFT Legacy Object Major intellectual contributions or lifetime works preserved for long-term historical value. E-NFT Enterprise Object Organizational artifacts such as research records, technical documentation, or certified institutional data. What Makes Them Valuable TrueMark Objects can support multiple forms of use and transfer. Depending on the creator's intent, an object may be: Sold Licensed Transferred Collected Inherited The value comes from the knowledge or artifact itself , while TrueMark provides the structure that preserves its authenticity and history. In Simple Terms A TrueMark Object turns knowledge into something that can be: Preserved Verified Owned Licensed or passed down to future generations. © 2026 spruked . Truth with teeth. page_knowledge.content_excerpt: About — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout About Spruked Spruked is a digital architecture studio focused on building systems that preserve knowledge, verify authenticity, and organize digital assets for the future . At its core, Spruked develops tools that allow individuals, professionals, and organizations to capture what they know, prove when it existed, and preserve it in a verifiable form . The modern world produces an overwhelming amount of information, but very little of it is structured, authenticated, or preserved in a meaningful way . Spruked exists to change that. Through a growing ecosystem of technologies — including CertSig™, TrueMark™, GOAT, and the Pro Prime Series AI systems — Spruked builds infrastructure that transforms knowledge into a durable digital asset. If knowledge has value, it deserves to be preserved properly. The Philosophy Spruked is built on a simple belief: "If better is possible, good is never enough." Most software is built to solve immediate problems. Spruked focuses on building systems that still make sense decades from now. The design philosophy emphasizes: Clarity over complexity Verification over assumption Permanence over convenience Discipline over novelty This approach guides every system within the Spruked ecosystem. What Spruked Builds Spruked develops several interconnected systems designed to support the preservation and verification of knowledge and digital artifacts. Key components include: CertSig™ A forensic-grade certificate system designed to produce verifiable digital records with layered authentication and metadata. CertSig allows documents, knowledge artifacts, and creative works to be issued with structured verification layers and optional blockchain anchoring. TrueMark™ A minting and verification framework that allows knowledge, intellectual property, and expertise to be issued as structured digital assets . The goal is not speculation or hype — but preservation and attribution. GOAT The GOAT system prepares and organizes digital artifacts before they are issued or archived. It acts as the preparation layer that ensures artifacts are structured, documented, and ready for long-term preservation. Pro Prime Series AI The Pro Prime Series explores the future of ethical, verifiable AI cognition systems . These systems focus on transparency, traceability, and philosophical grounding rather than opaque automation. Architecture draws inspiration from classical philosophy: Locke, Hume, Kant, and Spinoza. Why It Exists The internet solved distribution. It did not solve authenticity, permanence, or ownership of knowledge . Ideas disappear. Expertise is lost. Proof of authorship fades. Spruked exists to build the infrastructure that prevents that. The Founder My name is Bryan Spruk . I am a builder, salesman, systems thinker, and founder of the Pro Prime Series AI ecosystem. My professional background is not traditional. I did not come through a university program, venture studio, or corporate engineering track. I came through work: automotive sales, business development, welding, machining, entrepreneurship, customer service, and years of solving problems with limited resources. That background shaped the way I build. I tend to think in systems, structures, workflows, and practical outcomes. I am not interested in technology for show. I am interested in tools that help real people preserve knowledge, operate better, protect privacy, and turn difficult work into something usable. The projects I am building, including ORBS, GOAT, True Mark, CertSig, and related Pro Prime systems , come from that same place. chunks.text: What Are TrueMark Objects? — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout ← Back to TrueMark Mint What Are TrueMark Objects? TrueMark Objects are structured digital artifacts that represent verified knowledge, intellectual work, or meaningful historical records. Instead of being simple files or speculative tokens, a TrueMark Object combines several elements into a durable digital record. • The original artifact (document, knowledge, media, etc.) • A forensic certificate verifying its origin • A structured identifier • Authorship attribution • Timestamp verification • Preservation metadata Together these elements transform ordinary information into a verified digital object with a permanent record of origin. Why TrueMark Objects Exist Most knowledge today lives in fragile places: > PDFs that disappear > Cloud folders that get lost > Platforms that shut down > Research that loses attribution > Family knowledge that dies with a generation TrueMark Objects were created to solve this problem. They turn important knowledge into durable digital assets that can be preserved, verified, and transferred over time. Types of TrueMark Objects TrueMark uses several object types depending on the nature of the knowledge being preserved. K-NFT Knowledge Object A single artifact such as a book, document, research paper, or instructional guide. KL-NFT Knowledge License Collection A structured set of knowledge designed for licensing, such as courses, masterclasses, or training programs. H-NFT Heirloom Object Family knowledge intended to be passed down across generations, such as recipes, traditions, or historical records. L-NFT Legacy Object Major intellectual contributions or lifetime works preserved for long-term historical value. E-NFT Enterprise Object Organizational artifacts such as research records, technical documentation, or certified institutional data. What Makes Them Valuable TrueMark Objects can support multiple forms of use and transfer. Depending on the creator's intent, an object may be: Sold Licensed Transferred Collected Inherited The value comes from the knowledge or artifact itself , while TrueMark provides the structure that preserves its authenticity and history. In Simple Terms A TrueMark Object turns knowledge into something that can be: Preserved Verified Owned Licensed or passed down to future generations. © 2026 spruked . Truth with teeth. chunks.text: TrueMark Mint — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout TrueMark Mint Curated Registry Alpha CertSig Licensed Infrastructure TrueMark Mint The Curated Digital Object Vault TrueMark Mint is the founder-curated registry of verified digital knowledge objects issued through the Spruked ecosystem. Unlike typical NFT platforms that allow anyone to mint anything, TrueMark focuses on authenticity, provenance, and preservation of meaningful intellectual artifacts. Each object issued through TrueMark is intended to represent something real: Knowledge Expertise Creative work Technical documentation Intellectual property Personal legacy artifacts The goal is not speculation. The goal is preservation with attribution. The Distinction The Spruked ecosystem contains two different minting systems. TrueMark Mint The Curated Registry Artifacts issued through TrueMark are selected and issued through the founder vault. TrueMark is the museum. Alpha CertSig Licensed Infrastructure Organizations install and operate their own mint engine. Alpha CertSig is the printing press. This distinction protects the credibility and long-term integrity of the registry. What TrueMark Mints TrueMark issues Digital Knowledge Objects. These are structured artifacts designed to preserve valuable intellectual content. Examples include: Research findings Instructional knowledge Professional expertise Creative works Personal legacy messages Technical documentation Historical records Each object is preserved as a structured digital asset tied to a permanent certificate. The Digital Knowledge Object Model Traditional NFTs often represent artwork or speculative collectibles. TrueMark focuses on knowledge artifacts. A knowledge object includes: • The original artifact • A forensic certificate • A structured identifier • Authorship attribution • Timestamp verification • Preservation metadata These elements transform a simple file into a verified digital object. NFT Types in the TrueMark Registry TrueMark supports multiple object categories. K-NFT Knowledge Objects Knowledge NFTs preserve expertise and educational content. Examples include: Specialized tutorials Professional training Proprietary methods Technical insights These artifacts allow knowledge to be preserved and transferred across generations. H-NFT Heirloom Objects Heirloom NFTs preserve personal legacy artifacts. Examples include: Letters to future generations Family knowledge Personal messages Historical records These objects focus on long-term preservation of personal history. L-NFT Legacy Objects Legacy NFTs preserve significant intellectual or creative work. Examples include: Published works Major technical designs Documented discoveries Historical contributions These artifacts represent the long-term intellectual footprint of their creator. E-NFT Enterprise Objects Enterprise NFTs represent verified organizational artifacts. Examples include: Institutional records Internal research Certified documentation Digital twins Enterprise artifacts are often produced through Alpha CertSig infrastructure and may optionally appear in the TrueMark registry. Why TrueMark Exists Modern knowledge is fragile. > Files disappear. > Platforms vanish. > Creators lose attribution. TrueMark exists to ensure that meaningful digital artifacts are preserved with structure, verification, and historical context. Instead of existing as scattered files, knowledge becomes a durable digital object with a permanent record of origin. The Value of an Object Authorship Clear identification of the creator. Timestamped Origin Verifiable issuance record. Structured Preservation Artifacts stored with durable metadata. Transferable Knowledge Ideas and expertise that survive beyond their original creator. chunks.heading: AboutSpruked
chunks.text: About — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout About Spruked Spruked is a digital architecture studio focused on building systems that preserve knowledge, verify authenticity, and organize digital assets for the future . At its core, Spruked develops tools that allow individuals, professionals, and organizations to capture what they know, prove when it existed, and preserve it in a verifiable form . The modern world produces an overwhelming amount of information, but very little of it is structured, authenticated, or preserved in a meaningful way . Spruked exists to change that. Through a growing ecosystem of technologies — including CertSig™, TrueMark™, GOAT, and the Pro Prime Series AI systems — Spruked builds infrastructure that transforms knowledge into a durable digital asset. If knowledge has value, it deserves to be preserved properly. The Philosophy Spruked is built on a simple belief: "If better is possible, good is never enough." Most software is built to solve immediate problems. Spruked focuses on building systems that still make sense decades from now. The design philosophy emphasizes: Clarity over complexity Verification over assumption Permanence over convenience Discipline over novelty This approach guides every system within the Spruked ecosystem. What Spruked Builds Spruked develops several interconnected systems designed to support the preservation and verification of knowledge and digital artifacts. Key components include: CertSig™ A forensic-grade certificate system designed to produce verifiable digital records with layered authentication and metadata. CertSig allows documents, knowledge artifacts, and creative works to be issued with structured verification layers and optional blockchain anchoring. TrueMark™ A minting and verification framework that allows knowledge, intellectual property, and expertise to be issued as structured digital assets . The goal is not speculation or hype — but preservation and attribution. GOAT The GOAT system prepares and organizes digital artifacts before they are issued or archived. It acts as the preparation layer that ensures artifacts are structured, documented, and ready for long-term preservation. Pro Prime Series AI The Pro Prime Series explores the future of ethical, verifiable AI cognition systems . These systems focus on transparency, traceability, and philosophical grounding rather than opaque automation. Architecture draws inspiration from classical philosophy: Locke, Hume, Kant, and Spinoza. Why It Exists The internet solved distribution. It did not solve authenticity, permanence, or ownership of knowledge . Ideas disappear. Expertise is lost. Proof of authorship fades. Spruked exists to build the infrastructure that prevents that. The Founder My name is Bryan Spruk . I am a builder, salesman, systems thinker, and founder of the Pro Prime Series AI ecosystem. My professional background is not traditional. I did not come through a university program, venture studio, or corporate engineering track. I came through work: automotive sales, business development, welding, machining, entrepreneurship, customer service, and years of solving problems with limited resources. That background shaped the way I build. I tend to think in systems, structures, workflows, and practical outcomes. I am not interested in technology for show. I am interested in tools that help real people preserve knowledge, operate better, protect privacy, and turn difficult work into something usable. The projects I am building, including ORBS, GOAT, True Mark, CertSig, and related Pro Prime systems , come from that same place. They are local-first, privacy-conscious, practical systems designed to give individuals and small businesses more control over their own data, memory, work, and digital presence. chunks.text: Alpha CertSig Mint Engine — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout Alpha CertSig Elite Mint Engine Sovereign Digital Object Infrastructure Alpha CertSig is a self-hosted mint engine designed for institutions and sovereign creators who need forensic-grade digital object issuance without relying on third-party platforms. Unlike marketplace NFT systems, Alpha CertSig operates as licensed infrastructure that runs inside your own environment. Organizations use it to mint: Digital records Intellectual property Digital twins Certified documents Institutional knowledge objects The result is a structured, verifiable digital artifact that can be preserved indefinitely. The Market Has Changed The first wave of NFTs focused on speculation. The next wave focuses on infrastructure. Modern organizations are not interested in collectible tokens. They need systems capable of issuing forensic digital objects with long-term evidentiary value. They care about: Immutable internal records Forensic timestamping Digital twin infrastructure Verifiable intellectual property Sovereign data control Alpha CertSig was built for this new reality. The Key Distinction Two systems exist in the Spruked ecosystem. Alpha CertSig The licensed mint engine. Self-hosted Deployable infrastructure Licensable to organizations and individuals Designed for internal minting and digital object issuance True Mark Mint The founder's curated vault. Not licensable Not installable Not commoditized True Mark functions as the museum. Alpha CertSig is the printing press. This distinction remains permanent. Core Capabilities Infrastructure Ownership With Alpha CertSig, you purchase the engine once. There are no per-mint fees and no platform dependency. After the system is deployed, the cost of issuing digital objects approaches zero. Epistemic Sovereignty The system runs inside your own environment. Supported deployment models include: Docker Linux servers WSL2 environments Private blockchain networks No telemetry is required. Your records never leave your infrastructure. Forensic Certificate Architecture Alpha CertSig supports a multi-layer certificate structure. The flagship configuration includes 10 layers of forensic metadata embedded into each certificate. Optional encryption support includes: ChaCha20 secure object encryption Structured digital object identifiers Prefix-based registry architecture Example identifier: E-NFT-MAYO-MED-2026-000002 This identifier format creates a structured digital object record rather than a simple token reference. Example Certificate Output Example Forensic Certificate Output Generated by the Alpha CertSig mint engine and issued within the TrueMark registry. View Detailed Object Breakdown The Problems Alpha CertSig Solves The SaaS Tax Many platforms charge subscription fees plus minting costs. Alpha CertSig eliminates the platform dependency by giving organizations direct ownership of the mint engine. Data Sovereignty Sensitive documents and research often pass through third-party servers. Alpha CertSig performs all minting locally, allowing organizations to maintain complete control of their data. Evidentiary Weight Typical NFTs rely on lightweight metadata. Alpha CertSig produces structured objects designed for auditability, traceability, and institutional recordkeeping. Institutional Memory Loss Knowledge often disappears as staff turnover occurs. Alpha CertSig creates a structured digital library of internal knowledge artifacts that remain searchable and verifiable. Licensing Options Alpha CertSig is offered through a one-time license model with optional annual maintenance updates. Personal Node $3,900 License $500 Annual Maintenance (Optional) Includes: • Single prefix registry • 5-layer certificate system • DIY deployment • Community support Designed for developers and creators entering

chunks.text: spruked — Truth with teeth. spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout Example TrueMark Object Certified Digital Knowledge Artifact This certificate demonstrates what a finalized TrueMark digital object looks like after verification and preservation. Each artifact issued through the Spruked ecosystem receives a structured forensic certificate containing verification metadata, identifiers, and authentication layers. The certificate serves as the human-readable verification layer that accompanies the digital artifact. Download Artifact Sample Example Object Record Object Identifier K-NFT-SPRUK-ENG-2026-000014 Artifact Precision Lathe Retrofit Method Creator Bryan Anthony Spruk Category K-NFT Knowledge Object Verification 10-Layer Forensic Certificate Encryption ChaCha20-Poly1305 Certificate Elements Structured Identifier Every object is assigned a permanent identifier. Example: E-NFT-MAYO-MED-2026-000002 This identifier encodes: object type issuing prefix industry category year of issuance sequential object record Forensic Verification Layers Alpha CertSig certificates may include up to 10 forensic verification layers . These layers document technical information about the artifact including: file format verification resolution analysis cryptographic signatures metadata preservation structural integrity checks Encryption Layer Optional encryption modules protect the artifact and certificate from unauthorized alteration. The flagship configuration supports: ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption This provides authenticated encryption for high-security digital artifacts. QR Verification Each certificate may include a QR code linking to a verification endpoint or registry entry. This allows the certificate to be quickly verified using a mobile device. TrueMark Seal The TrueMark seal indicates that the object has been issued within the curated registry and has passed the required verification processes. The seal acts as a visual authenticity marker for the artifact. Why the Certificate Matters The certificate transforms a simple file into a verifiable digital artifact . Instead of existing as an isolated document, the artifact becomes a structured record containing: authorship timestamped origin forensic verification permanent identification preservation metadata This ensures that the knowledge or artifact can be verified long after its original creation. Where Certificates Come From Certificates like this are generated through the Alpha CertSig mint engine . The engine performs the verification steps, generates the structured identifier, and produces the forensic certificate that accompanies the artifact. Selected artifacts may also appear in the TrueMark registry , preserving them within the curated archive of digital knowledge objects. Explore Alpha CertSig View TrueMark Registry © 2026 spruked . chunks.title: TrueMark Digital Object Types — Spruked
chunks.heading: TrueMark DigitalObject Types
chunks.text: TrueMark Digital Object Types — Spruked spruked Home Products ORB About Evidence Cart Checkout Home Company About Products All Products Alpha CertSig TrueMark Mint The GOAT Orb Skin Studio Platform Evidence Admin Cart Checkout ← Back to TrueMark Mint TrueMark Digital Object Types Understanding Knowledge NFTs TrueMark objects are designed to preserve knowledge, expertise, and meaningful digital artifacts in a structured and verifiable form. Unlike speculative NFTs, TrueMark objects represent real intellectual artifacts that can be preserved, licensed, transferred, or inherited over time. Each NFT type exists to serve a different purpose in the preservation of knowledge and digital legacy. K-NFT Knowledge Object KL-NFT Licensed Knowledge H-NFT Heirloom Object L-NFT Legacy Object E-NFT Enterprise Object K-NFT Knowledge Object A K-NFT represents a single intellectual artifact or a tightly related set of artifacts. These objects preserve a specific piece of knowledge in a durable digital format. Examples A single book or manuscript A research paper A technical document An engineering method A proprietary process An instructional guide A creative work Value Model A K-NFT can be: Sold to another party Licensed for use or distribution Transferred to institutions or collectors In many cases, a K-NFT functions like a digital edition of an intellectual artifact , preserved with permanent authorship and timestamp verification. Certificate Representation KL-NFT Knowledge License Collection A KL-NFT represents a structured collection of knowledge artifacts designed for licensing and distribution. Where a K-NFT represents a single artifact, a KL-NFT represents a complete knowledge system. Examples Professional training courses Masterclass programs Structured learning systems Educational curriculum Research collections Multi-part technical instruction Value Model KL-NFTs are designed to be licensed repeatedly . Owners may: License access to the content Distribute learning programs Offer certification or training based on the material This makes KL-NFTs ideal for educators, subject-matter experts, and organizations that want to preserve and distribute structured expertise. H-NFT Heirloom Object An H-NFT preserves knowledge and artifacts intended to be passed down across generations. These objects focus on family legacy and cultural preservation. Examples Family recipes Letters to future generations Historical family documents Farming knowledge passed through generations Craftsmanship techniques Cultural traditions These artifacts may contain knowledge that has been preserved within families for decades or even centuries. Value Model Heirloom NFTs may be: Inherited across generations Preserved as family archives Licensed if the knowledge becomes valuable to others The primary goal of an H-NFT is preservation and continuity of family knowledge. L-NFT Legacy Object An L-NFT represents significant intellectual contributions or life-work artifacts. These objects often preserve work that has long-term historical or intellectual importance. Examples Major discoveries Important technical designs Lifetime research collections Influential creative works Historical documentation Legacy NFTs preserve the long-term intellectual footprint of a creator or organization. Value Model Legacy objects may be: Transferred to archives or institutions Preserved as historical records Licensed for educational or research use These artifacts are often created to ensure that meaningful contributions are not lost over time. E-NFT Enterprise Object An E-NFT represents digital objects created by organizations or institutions. These objects often originate from systems such as Alpha CertSig infrastructure and may represent internal or external artifacts.
